size, read from the header first
blosc with snappy: refused at open
one view's budget, to scale: 256 MiB, 1.6 px a MiB
a chunk reserves up to 16 MiB; 3 reads in flight
before: reserved, then the wait for a slot
16 reserves of 16 MiB fill it, 13 of them only queued
at most 3 times 16 MiB held, the rest free; unused
reserve given back; 2000 requests a view
a body past a cut reserve: Stopped(bytes);

the 16 MiB reserve was taken before the wait for one of 3 slots: a multi-channel first paint stopped
fixed test first: reserved in the slot, 40 concurrent gets succeed, a 2 MiB chunk with 1 MiB left stops
